## Design note

The V-Spec II is the GT-R for people who take it to the track: lower and stiffer, with the front undertray and carbon diffuser that kill high-speed lift, and the Active LSD that pushes the rear into the corner on power. It is a touch heavier and draggier than the standard car, but steadier and quicker everywhere that turns. The carbon bonnet with its NACA duct is the giveaway.

## How this car breaks

As the standard GT-R, aluminium front wings included, but the bonnet is carbon fibre: lighter, and it cracks and flies off rather than folding. The air dam and diffuser sit low and are scraped off by kerbs and ramps; the Active LSD and its hydraulics make a rear hit costlier.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 676 | 0.80 | 540 |
| pitch | 3089 | 0.88 | 2720 |
| yaw | 3268 | 0.90 | 2940 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 2.04 m²; Cd = 0.36 → **CdA = 0.734 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.05 / +0.08 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). Add-on aero `aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0.07 F / 0.07 R m² ([S11] V-Spec aero: deeper front air dam, front underbody undertray and carbon rear diffuser; [E] sized so the net Cl·A is ≈ −0.02 front / +0.01 rear (Nissan's near-zero-lift claim for the V-Spec)). Net downforce Cl·A 0.02 F / -0.01 R m² → 3 kg at 250 km/h, 200% front (static weight 57% front).

## Engine

RB26DETT 2.6 L DOHC 24-valve I6, twin ceramic-wheel ball-bearing turbos, intercooled, individual throttles. Rated 206 kW (280 PS) @ 6800 rpm, 392 N·m @ 4400 [S19][S20] under the JDM gentleman's agreement; real-world factor ×1.12: ≈439 N·m @ 4400 and ≈239 kW @ 6000 rpm (the [E] curve shape already carries 213 kW at 6000 before the factor). Stock cars dyno ≈240-250 kW at the crank and ≈200 kW at the wheels [S19?]; ×1.12 sits at the conservative end of those reports. Curve shape [E] on the rated points, boost from ≈3000 rpm.

## Drivetrain

Getrag 233 6-speed manual (FS6R92A), ATTESA E-TS Pro: ATTESA E-TS (nominal 0:100, up to 50:50 when the rears slip) approximated as a fixed 30 % front split: the contract cannot express a rear-primary coupling yet (requested in docs/integration/cars.md); open front differential, electro-hydraulic rear Active LSD approximated as a stronger clutch LSD (higher preload and power ramp, gentle coast ramp for turn-in). Layout **AWD, 30 % front**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 140 N·m, power ramp 0.55, coast ramp 0.25. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 610 N·m. Shift time 0.42 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.31 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 434 kg | 1.95 Hz | 65200 N/m | 3300 N·s/m | 4950 N·s/m | 0.13 m |
| Rear | 321 kg | 2.15 Hz | 58600 N/m | 2690 N·s/m | 4040 N·s/m | 0.14 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 1.9°/g with 52% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.363 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 172880 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 71365 F / 65090 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **8500 F / 8100 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 1.9°/g, front share 52%. Bump stops 180000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -1.0° F / -1.5° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 5.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 324 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm + 42 mm → A = 25.2 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 137 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·25.2 cm²·0.137 m = **2900 N·m**
- Rear: 300 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm → A = 11.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 125 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·11.3 cm²·0.125 m = **1134 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1859 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.56×), rear needs 644 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.75×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1005 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.529** → delivered 2900 N·m front / 1006 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1620 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.6 m → outer-front path radius 5.68 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.27 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.558 rad (32.0°)** (outer 28.0°, inner 37.0° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.55). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.
